We need to propose retrosynthesis route using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order. Must have at least 3 reactions. Likely each template corresponds to a specific disconnection. We need to check applicability to target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to apply each template sequentially retrosynthetically, generating precursors. Use apply_template tool to get possible precursors for each step. Then construct JSON route: root is target molecule, children are reaction nodes with template_id, each reaction node children are precursor molecules (type mol). Then each precursor may be further broken by next reaction etc.

We need to ensure order: first apply template 1914393 to target, then 1914394 to one of the resulting precursors, then 1914395 to another, etc. At least 3 reactions.

Let's try to see if templates exist. Use get_template to see details maybe.
